archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Cinematic Dashboard

layout_and_spacing.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.bento_strategy: Control Room Grid for dashboard: Dense data presentation, tight gaps, full viewport height utilization.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-md (max 8px border-radius, prefer sharp edges for Swiss aesthetic)

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#FF453A] hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors

components.cards: border border-white/10 bg-[#121212] rounded-md shadow-sm overflow-hidden
components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF3B30] focus:border-[#FF3B30] focus:outline-none w-full
components.navigation: Solid background bg-[#050505] with bottom border border-white/10. Top nav with logo left, user navigation links right. z-50 sticky top-0.
components.video_player_container: aspect-video bg-black rounded-md border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden

scene_forest_placeholder.usage: Use as mocked generated scene image (Option 1).

scene_lab_placeholder.usage: Use as mocked generated scene image (Option 2).

video_timeline_placeholder.description: Video editing timeline interface abstract background.
video_timeline_placeholder.usage: Use for the final stitched video placeholder in the Final Export Page.

user_avatar.description: A man with a tie and sunglasses on his head.
user_avatar.usage: Use for user profile/avatar in the admin dashboard and top navigation.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or lucide-react for iconography. Minimalist, technical aesthetic.
Apply 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) and key state indicators for testing.
The 'Admin Page' data tables must be dense and cardless, using subtle 1px row borders for separation.
For the 'Scene breakdown editor', use a dense bento 'Control Room' grid so users can edit script/duration/visual prompts efficiently side-by-side.
Implement the 'Expand Next 5 Seconds' action as a subtle secondary CTA alongside the generated video segments.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>. Rely heavily on Shadcn UI customized with the dark color palette.
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors (e.g., hover:text-white) rather than inheriting, to prevent contrast bugs.
Ensure Final Export page uses the video_timeline_placeholder in an aspect-video container to visualize stitched clips.
